messages:
Eli H: Noticed a tiny but consistent stream of fncall schema rejects routing to the degen path in us-east starting ~08:40 UTC. ~12 rejects/min from one partner org.
Sara V: I see it too on the validation dashboard. Mostly tool_output shape mismatches.
Ravi K: Any sample payloads? that helps decide if validator should coerce.
Eli H: Sanitized example: 
```json
{\"session\":\"s_99\",\"tool_output\":[{\"line\":1,\"text\":\"ok\"}]}
```
Eli H: Our schema expects {"items": [...] } not a bare array, so strict gate rejects.
infra-bot: Alert: fncall_schema_reject_rate (us-east) > 1.5% for 10m; paging @eng-platform. https://console/redwood/alerts/9982
Sara V: Ops: can we bump sampling for rejects so we capture full decode + model outputs? current sample is tiny.
Ravi K: Temporary fix: flip per-org flag validation.soft=true for the partner until they patch serializer. Low-risk. Also tag those requests with validation_debug=soft for telemetry.
Marta L: Console UX request: show top-3 schema diffs per route and a scrubbed example payload. small widget under fncall -> diagnostics.
Design-bot: Note: widget should include a validator-diff view (expected vs observed) and redaction toggle.
Eli H: Telemetry gap: we currently count fallback events but don't split by cause. Propose metric fncall_validation_cause with values {schema_mismatch, parse_error, decode_noise}.
Sara V: Agreed. Short-term emit trace tag validation_cause=schema_mismatch for these. We'll schedule a metric deploy next sprint.
Ravi K: Billing: requests routed to degen are billed as full fncall. Finance asks whether soft-validated fallbacks should be charged at reduced rate. Who owns decision?
Marta L: Product/Finance should decide. I'll loop in finance and add to backlog.
Eli H: Implemented per-org soft flip and sampling bump (10%) for 1h. After flip, rejects from that org dropped to 0-1/min.
Sara V: Saving this as an incident note. Postmortem items: add SDK helper to normalize tool_output union, update docs, add telemetry split, and Console widget RFC.
Ravi K: PR for runtime flag + trace tags: https://git/redwood/pulls/4410
Marta L: I'll create the Console ticket for the widget and assign to UX.
Eli H: Leaving open to monitor for 45m. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
